question: In the same held-context Tahoe task, do additional reproducible measured baseline details and requested response details continue to add recoverable response signal?
scope: Operational evidence for measurement resolution versus task-useful information and supported prediction resolution; no information-theoretic upper bound.
split: Five deterministic balanced context-disjoint outer folds; five balanced context-disjoint inner folds. All target treated responses on both plates excluded from every baseline-only fit and basis.
input_normalization: Existing per-profile gene centering and L2 normalization. PCA trained separately on each plate and recomputed inside each inner split; no score whitening. Linear kernel scaled by training mean squared norm.
model_selection: For each input dimension and family minimize pooled inner cross-plate full-response error; shared hyperparameters, separately fitted plate weights. No outer-outcome selection.
output_basis: Training-context intervention-specific centered true responses; one plate at a time, reverse plate roles, same orthogonal projector for paired scoring. Exact training-row Gram eigendecomposition; numerical span eigenvalue cutoff 1e-8 times maximum, positive eigenvalues only. Frozen rank cap 1024 for intermediate ranks; complete numerical span additionally scored.
response_target: Delta[c,p] minus intervention-specific mean over outer-training contexts, per plate. Same target, references, folds and units for every input/model/output comparison.
aggregation: Pool energies before ratios; average plate-basis directions at contribution level; do not clip signed energies or ratios. Nonpositive ratio denominators undefined.

primary_contrasts.input: RBF PCA16 versus RBF full RNA; additional measured signal and recovery difference
primary_contrasts.output: RBF full RNA rank64 versus full response; added truth signal and full-normalized recovery difference

adaptive_policy: Select input dimension within each family using inner full-response error: smallest available representation within 0.02 of maximum inner normalized recovery. Choose smallest output rank preserving at least 95% of maximum positive inner U for that input/model. If maximum U is nonpositive, report no supported resolution. Inner response bases exclude inner-validation contexts. Evaluate frozen choices on outer contexts.
uncertainty: 10000 paired context-then-intervention bootstrap draws; no refits. Pointwise intervals for frozen primary contrasts; simultaneous max-standardized absolute-deviation intervals for displayed model/input/output contrast families. Conditional on fitted models. Fold/plate-direction sensitivity reported.
controls: full input and numerical training-span input
full response and numerical training-span output
followup_information_test: After the baseline joint analysis, fixed 4/16/92 target anchors may be evaluated with training-only shrinkage of an additive response residual, with target intervention excluded. Report separately and do not use it to select the baseline analysis.
interpretation: Input compactness alone does not imply coarse outputs. Support requires nontrivial reproducible omitted structure plus preserved or improved held-out prediction under explicit uncertainty. Failure of equivalence due to wide intervals is inconclusive. Superior alternative estimator indicates estimator limitation. No forced monotonic curves or post-hoc threshold changes.
compute_gate: Pilot runtime and memory only, before held-out scoring. Aim under 2 hours and 8 GiB GPU; implementation optimization allowed without changing mathematical analysis.
preservation: Create isolated experiment files only. Do not edit manuscripts, figures, release artifacts or earlier results. This is a new analysis on a previously studied dataset, not an independent preregistered validation cohort.
